overall_reason: The cool slate scene is muted to one value band: the window text is #65717c on #303a45, and the front preview card is a grey #cbd1d8 with #a1aab5 text, so no layer carries full ink or paper.

score.reason: T-SURFACE-LADDER and T-GRAYSCALE find no layer that stands forward, and T-PALETTE-ROLES finds one grey per surface for headings and meta alike; the cool source holds, which keeps it at 3.

findings.title: Depth comes from lightness and one shadow
findings.where: preview card and workspace window, 1440 and 375, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P34\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png and C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P34\03-lenses\color\gray-fold-1440.png
findings.evidence: The front card fills with #cbd1d8 (17.1% of the area at 375) instead of a paper white, and the window behind it is #303a45; in the grayscale fold every layer sits in the middle of the range and the front card does not read as the focus.
findings.before: Front card #cbd1d8 with #a1aab5 text; window #303a45 with #65717c text
findings.after: A lightness ladder with one end at full paper and ink: the front card at the page's paper value with dark ink, the receding window darker and quieter
findings.why: When every layer is dimmed, nothing tells the eye which object is the subject.
findings.root: the dimmed surface and text tokens

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.where: all text in the window and the preview card, 1440, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P34\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table finds 2 text greys: #65717c on 9 elements on the dark window (including the h3 'Launch assets' and the window title) and #a1aab5 on 7 elements on the card (including the heading 'Launch brief').
findings.before: Headings and meta share one grey per surface
findings.after: An ink step per surface: headings at full ink for that surface, meta one step lighter
findings.why: With headings and meta in one grey, the hierarchy inside each layer is lost as well.

strengths: The neutrals hold one cool temperature (22 cool against 1 untinted), so the palette's source is consistent.
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
